title: Free vs Paid Exam Prep Apps: What You Actually Get
excerpt: What to look for in a citizenship, driving theory or certification prep app, and when paying is worth it.
description: What to look for in an exam prep app: up-to-date questions, real exam format, explanations and progress tracking. When free is enough and when to pay.
body:
There are hundreds of exam prep apps. Here's how to tell a good one from a bad one, whether it's free or paid.

## What every good prep app needs

- **Up-to-date questions.** Exams change. Check that the app names the current year or exam version.
- **The real exam format.** Mock tests should match the real number of questions, time limit and pass mark.
- **Explanations.** Knowing why an answer is right is how you learn, not just memorise.
- **Progress tracking.** You should be able to see which topics are weak.

## When free is enough

Free practice is great for finding out where you stand. If you're already scoring well, a few free mock tests may be all you need.

## When paying is worth it

If you're starting from scratch, or you keep missing the pass mark, a full question bank, unlimited mocks and a mistakes review usually save you time. That matters when a failed attempt costs you another fee and another wait.

## Watch out for

- Subscriptions that are hard to cancel
- Apps that ask for permissions they don't need
- Question banks that don't say which exam version they cover
